title: Insert many rows in batches

blocks.text: Calling `executeUpdate()` once per row costs one round trip per row. The page's fix queues rows with `addBatch()` and sends them with `executeBatch()`, in chunks (the page uses 1000) so a huge input does not pile up in memory.

Write `BatchInsert.insertAll(connection, names, chunkSize)`. It inserts each name into `people(name)` with one `PreparedStatement` and returns the number of rows inserted (the sum of the counts `executeBatch()` returns).

items: **One `executeBatch()` per chunk** of `chunkSize` rows, never one call per row.
**The last, partial chunk is sent as well.**

cases.says: insertAll() with 4 names and chunks of 2 inserts all 4 rows and returns 4.
5 names in chunks of 2 reach the database in 3 executeBatch calls and no executeUpdate call.
5 names in chunks of 2 insert all 5 rows: the last chunk of 1 is sent too.
A chunk size of 0 throws IllegalArgumentException before anything is inserted.

origin.section: 4. Not Using Batch for Bulk Operations

concepts: addBatch() and executeBatch() send many rows in one round trip, executed in chunks for very large inputs.
